## Libraries
```{r import libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(sjPlot)
library(performance)
library(ggeffects)
library(patchwork)

```

## Data Wranging
```{r Data Wrangling}
# Data across all weeks 
weekly <- read_xlsx("Brewers Plots/DataFiles/Capstone Data_10_14.xlsx", sheet = "Weekly Brewers Bay monitoring")
weekly$Date <- as.Date(weekly$Date)

# Extracting the width, length, height one time measurements
onetime <- read_xlsx("Brewers Plots/DataFiles/Capstone Data_10_14.xlsx", sheet = "One Time Measurements") %>% 
  select(-Date)


# Joining one time data across all weeks and selecting columns
brewers_weekly<- weekly %>%
  left_join(onetime, by = "Plot ID") %>% 
  select("Date", "Plot ID":"Grwth/O", "Hedging Type", "N Length (cm)":"W Width (cm)") 

brewers_weekly <- brewers_weekly %>%
  rename("Hedging.Type" = "Hedging Type",
         "Meets.Hedge" = "Meets Hedge")
brewers_weekly$Hedging.Type[brewers_weekly$Hedging.Type == "B"] <- "W"

# filter out the days before data collection stated (started 02-28-2026)
brewers_weekly <- brewers_weekly |> 
  filter(!Date %in% as.Date(c("2026-02-23", "2026-02-25")))

```

```{r}
prob_graph <- function(pred, yvalJitter, tag, ylab){
    graph <- ggplot({{pred}}, aes(x = x, y = predicted, color = group)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  geom_jitter(data = brewers_weekly, aes(x = day, y = {{yvalJitter}}, color = Hedging.Type),
              alpha = 0.4, width = 0.7, height = 0.01) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high, fill = group),
              alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +
scale_color_discrete(labels = c(
    "W" = "WB",
    "C" = "Control",
    "G" = "GB",
    "M" = "SCR",
    "R" = "LCR"
  )) +
  labs(color = "Hedging Type", tag = tag) +
  ylab(ylab)+
  xlab(expression(paste("Day Since ", italic("T. testudinum"), " Plug Planting")))+
  scale_fill_discrete(guide = "none") +
  theme_minimal()+
    theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 20),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 20),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 25),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 25),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 22),
    plot.tag = element_text(size = 25, face = "bold"))
    return(graph)}

prob_graph_LCR <- function(pred, yvalJitter, tag, ylab){
    graph <- ggplot({{pred}}, aes(x = x, y = predicted, color = group)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  geom_jitter(data = brewers_weekly_LCR, aes(x = day, y = {{yvalJitter}}, color = Hedging.Type),
              alpha = 0.4, width = 0.7, height = 0.01) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high, fill = group),
              alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +
scale_color_discrete(labels = c(
    "W" = "WB",
    "C" = "Control",
    "G" = "GB",
    "M" = "SCR",
    "R" = "aLCR"
  )) +
  labs(color = "Hedging Type", tag = tag) +
  ylab(ylab)+
  xlab(expression(paste("Day Since ", italic("T. testudinum"), " Plug Planting")))+
  scale_fill_discrete(guide = "none") +
  theme_minimal()+
    theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 20),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 20),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 25),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 25),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 22),
    plot.tag = element_text(size = 25, face = "bold"))
    return(graph)}
```

## Including time
```{r}
# predicting the day at which the seagrass meets the head
# Calulating the days since the start of the data collection
brewers_weekly$day <- brewers_weekly$Date - brewers_weekly$Date[1]
# number of days since starting is now the response variable
brewers_weekly$day <- as.numeric(brewers_weekly$day)
  
## Meets Hedge with time
meetsmodeltime <- glm(`Meets.Hedge` ~ `Hedging.Type` + day, family = "binomial", data = brewers_weekly)
summary(meetsmodeltime)

check_model(meetsmodeltime)
check_overdispersion(meetsmodeltime)

#***meeting hedge prob***
pred_m <- ggpredict(meetsmodeltime, terms = c("day", "Hedging.Type"))

m <- prob_graph(pred_m, Meets.Hedge, "A", "P(Meeting the Hedge)")
#shows at what day does the H. stipulacea meet the hedge

## Growth Over with time
brewers_weekly$`Grwth/O`<- as.integer(brewers_weekly$`Grwth/O`)
gOmodeltime <- glm(`Grwth/O` ~ `Hedging.Type` + as.numeric(day), family = "binomial", data = brewers_weekly)
summary(gOmodeltime)

check_model(gOmodeltime)
check_overdispersion(gOmodeltime)

pred_O <- ggpredict(gOmodeltime, terms = c("day", "Hedging.Type"))

#***growth over prob***
o <- prob_graph(pred_O, `Grwth/O`, "B", "P(Over the Hedge)")
#shows at what day does the H. stipulacea Grow Over the hedge

## Growth Under with time
gUmodeltime <- glm(`Grwth/U` ~ `Hedging.Type` + as.numeric(day), family = "binomial", data = brewers_weekly)
summary(gUmodeltime)

check_model(gUmodeltime)
check_overdispersion(gUmodeltime)

pred_U <- ggpredict(gUmodeltime, terms = c("day", "Hedging.Type"))

#***growth Under prob***

u <- prob_graph(pred_U, `Grwth/U`, "C", "P(Under the Hedge)")

#shows at what day does the H. stipulacea Grow Under the hedge

##***one figure Panel***

combined_plot <- m / o / u
combined_plot
ggsave("Brewers Plots/Figures/combined_probability.png", plot = combined_plot, dpi = 300, width = 8,height = 12,units = "in") 

```
 the seagrass changing through time 
 even in this short time we are seeing a significant effect of day 
 
## LCR as baseline 
```{r}
brewers_weekly_LCR <- brewers_weekly |> 
  mutate(Hedging.Type = recode(Hedging.Type, "LCR" = "aLCR"))

## Meets Hedge with time
meetsmodeltime_LCR <- glm(`Meets.Hedge` ~ `Hedging.Type` + day, family = "binomial", data = brewers_weekly_LCR)
summary(meetsmodeltime_LCR)

check_model(meetsmodeltime_LCR)
check_overdispersion(meetsmodeltime_LCR)

pred_m_LCR <- ggpredict(meetsmodeltime, terms = c("day", "Hedging.Type"))

m_lcr <- prob_graph_LCR(pred_m_LCR, Meets.Hedge, "A", "P(Meeting the Hedge)")

## Growth Over with time
gOmodeltime_LCR <- glm(`Grwth/O` ~ `Hedging.Type` + as.numeric(day), family = "binomial", data = brewers_weekly_LCR)
summary(gOmodeltime_LCR)

check_model(gOmodeltime_LCR)
check_overdispersion(gOmodeltime_LCR)

pred_O_LCR <- ggpredict(gOmodeltime_LCR, terms = c("day", "Hedging.Type"))

o_lcr <- prob_graph_LCR(pred_O_LCR, `Grwth/O`, "B", "P(Over the Hedge)")

## Growth Under with time
gUmodeltime_LCR <- glm(`Grwth/U` ~ `Hedging.Type` + as.numeric(day), family = "binomial", data = brewers_weekly_LCR)
summary(gUmodeltime_LCR)

check_model(gUmodeltime_LCR)
check_overdispersion(gUmodeltime_LCR)

pred_U_LCR <- ggpredict(gUmodeltime, terms = c("day", "Hedging.Type"))

u_lcr <- prob_graph_LCR(pred_U_LCR, `Grwth/U`, "C", "P(Under the Hedge)")

##***one figure Panel***

LCR_combined_plot <- m_lcr / o_lcr / u_lcr
LCR_combined_plot
ggsave("Brewers Plots/Figures/LCR_combined_probability.png", plot = LCR_combined_plot, dpi = 300, width = 8,height = 12,units = "in") 

```
